text_en: Then he began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a fence around it, dug a pit for the wine press, and built a watchtower; then he leased it to tenants and went to another country.
text_cn: 耶稣开始用比喻对他们说：“有一个人培植了一个葡萄园，周围围上篱笆，掘了一个榨酒池，筑了一座守望台，把它租给园户，就离开了本国。

text_en: When the season came, he sent a slave to the tenants to collect from them his share of the produce of the vineyard.
text_cn: 到了时节，他便打发一个仆人到园户那里，向园户收取园中的果实；

text_en: But they seized him, and beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
text_cn: 园户却抓住他，打了他，放他空手回去。

text_en: And again he sent another slave to them; this one they beat over the head and insulted.
text_cn: 主人又打发别的一个仆人到他们那里去；他们打伤了他的头，并且凌辱了他。

text_en: Then he sent another, and that one they killed. And so it was with many others; some they beat, and others they killed.
text_cn: 主人又打发另一个，他们把他杀了；后又打发好些仆人去：有的他们打了，有的他们杀了。

text_en: He had still one other, a beloved son. Finally he sent him to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son. ’
text_cn: 主人还有一个，即他的爱子；最后就打发他到他们那里去，说：他们必会敬重我的儿子。

text_en: But those tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours. ’
text_cn: 那些园户却彼此说：这是继承人，来！我们杀掉他，将来产业就归我们了。

text_en: So they seized him, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
text_cn: 于是，抓住他杀了，把他抛在葡萄园外。

text_en: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the tenants and give the vineyard to others.
text_cn: 那么，葡萄园的主人要怎样处置呢？他必来除灭这些园户，将葡萄园另租给别人。

text_en: Have you not read this scripture: ‘The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
text_cn: 你们没有读过这段经文吗？‘匠人弃而不用的石头，反而成了屋角的基石：

text_en: this was the Lord’s doing, and it is amazing in our eyes’? ”
text_cn: 那是上主的所作所为，在我们眼中神妙莫测。’”

text_en: When they realized that he had told this parable against them, they wanted to arrest him, but they feared the crowd. So they left him and went away.
text_cn: 他们明白这比喻是指他们说的，就想逮住他；但害怕群众，于是，离开他走了。

text_en: Then they sent to him some Pharisees and some Herodians to trap him in what he said.
text_cn: 后来，他们派了几个法利塞人和黑落德党人到耶稣那里，要用言论来陷害他。

text_en: And they came and said to him, “Teacher, we know that you are sincere, and show deference to no one; for you do not regard people with partiality, but teach the way of God in accordance with truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to the emperor, or not?
text_cn: 他们来对他说：“师傅！我们知道你是真诚的，不顾忌任何人，因为你不看人的情面，只按真理教授天主的道路。给凯撒纳丁税，可以不可以？我们该纳不该纳？”

text_en: Should we pay them, or should we not? ” But knowing their hypocrisy, he said to them, “Why are you putting me to the test? Bring me a denarius and let me see it. ”
text_cn: 耶稣识破了他们的虚伪，便对他们说：“你们为什么试探我？拿一个‘德纳’来给我看看！”

text_en: And they brought one. Then he said to them, “Whose head is this, and whose title? ” They answered, “The emperor’s. ”
text_cn: 他们拿了来。耶稣就问他们说：“这肖像和字号是谁的？”他们回答说：“凯撒的。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Give to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s. ” And they were utterly amazed at him.
text_cn: 耶稣就对他们说：“凯撒的就应归还凯撒，天主的就应归还天主。”他们对他非常惊异。

text_en: Some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him and asked him a question, saying,
text_cn: 否认复活的撒杜塞人来到耶稣跟前，问他说：

text_en: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies, leaving a wife but no child, the man shall marry the widow and raise up children for his brother.
text_cn: “师傅！梅瑟曾给我们写说：如果一个人的哥哥死了，撇下妻子而没留下孩子，他的弟弟就应娶他的妻子，给他哥哥立嗣。

text_en: There were seven brothers; the first married and, when he died, left no children;
text_cn: 曾有兄弟七人，第一个娶了妻，没有留下子嗣就死了。

text_en: and the second married the widow and died, leaving no children; and the third likewise;
text_cn: 第二个娶了她，也没有留下子嗣就死了；第三个也是这样。

text_en: none of the seven left children. Last of all the woman herself died.
text_cn: 那七个都没有留下子嗣；末了，那妇人也死了。

text_en: In the resurrection whose wife will she be? For the seven had married her. ”
text_cn: 在复活时，他们复活以后，她将是他们中那一个人的妻子？因为七个人都娶过她为妻。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Is not this the reason you are wrong, that you know neither the scriptures nor the power of God?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们岂不是因为没有明了经书，也没有明了天主的能力，而错误了吗？

text_en: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
text_cn: 因为人从死者中复活后，也不娶，也不嫁，就像天上的天使一样。

text_en: And as for the dead being raised, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the story about the bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
text_cn: 关于死人复活的事，在《梅瑟书》上《荆棘篇》中，你们没有读过，天主怎样对他说的吗？他说：‘我是亚巴郎的天主，依撒格的天主，和雅各伯的天主。’

text_en: He is God not of the dead, but of the living; you are quite wrong. ”
text_cn: 他不是死人的，而是活人的天主，所以你们大错了！”

text_en: One of the scribes came near and heard them disputing with one another, and seeing that he answered them well, he asked him, “Which commandment is the first of all? ”
text_cn: 有一个经师听见了他们辩论，觉得耶稣对他们回答的好，便上前来，问他说：“一切诫命中，那一条是第一条呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “The first is, ‘Hear, O Israel: the Lord our God, the Lord is one;
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“第一条是：‘以色列！你要听！上主我们的天主是唯一的天主。

text_en: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength. ’
text_cn: 你应当全心、全灵、全意、全力爱上主，你的天主。’

text_en: The second is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself. ’ There is no other commandment greater than these. ”
text_cn: 第二条是：‘你应当爱近人如你自己。’再没有别的诫命比这两条更大的了。”

text_en: Then the scribe said to him, “You are right, Teacher; you have truly said that ‘he is one, and besides him there is no other’;
text_cn: 那经师对耶稣说：“不错，师傅说的实在对：他是唯一的，除他以外，再没有别的：

text_en: and ‘to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, ’ and ‘to love one’s neighbor as oneself, ’—this is much more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices. ”
text_cn: 应以全心、全意、全力爱他，并爱近人如自己，远超过一切全燔祭和牺牲。”

text_en: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God. ” After that no one dared to ask him any question.
text_cn: 耶稣见他回答的明智，便对他说：“你离天主的国不远了。”从此，没有人敢再问他。

text_en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, “How can the scribes say that the Messiah is the son of David?
text_cn: 耶稣在圣殿里教训人时，说道：“经师们怎么说默西亚是达味之子呢？

text_en: David himself, by the Holy Spirit, declared, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I put your enemies under your feet. ”’
text_cn: 达味自己因着圣神的感动曾说过：‘上主对吾主说：你坐在我右边，等我把你的仇人放在你的脚下。’

text_en: David himself calls him Lord; so how can he be his son? ” And the large crowd was listening to him with delight.
text_cn: 达味自己既称他为主，他怎么又是达味之子呢？” 大批群众都喜欢听他。

text_en: As he taught, he said, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk around in long robes, and to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces,
text_cn: 耶稣在教训中又说：“你们要谨防经师：他们喜欢穿上长袍游行，在街市上受人请安，

text_en: and to have the best seats in the synagogues and places of honor at banquets!
text_cn: 在会堂里坐上座，在筵席上坐首席；

text_en: They devour widows’ houses and for the sake of appearance say long prayers. They will receive the greater condemnation. ”
text_cn: 他们吞没了寡妇的家产，而以长久的祈祷作掩饰：这些人必要遭受更严重的处罚。”

text_en: He sat down opposite the treasury, and watched the crowd putting money into the treasury. Many rich people put in large sums.
text_cn: 耶稣面对银库坐着，看众人怎样向银库里投钱，有许多富人投了很多。

text_en: A poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which are worth a penny.
text_cn: 那时，来了一个穷寡妇，投了两个小钱，即一文铜钱的四分之一。

text_en: Then he called his disciples and said to them, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who are contributing to the treasury.
text_cn: 耶稣便叫他的门徒过来，对他们说：“我实在告诉你们：这个穷寡妇比所有向银库投钱的人，投的更多，

text_en: For all of them have contributed out of their abundance; but she out of her poverty has put in everything she had, all she had to live on. ”
text_cn: 因为众人都拿他们所余的来投；但这寡妇却由自己的不足中，把所有的一切，全部的生活费，都投上了。”
